name: lif-workflow
description: Cross-repository workflow for LIF coding agents: session handoff (handoff, pickup), single-issue and PR loops (issue-implement, issue-review, pr-shepherd), Apple HIG UI design and audit (ui-hig), prompt rewriting for Opus 5.5 (prompt-optimize), vault conventions (obsidian-vault), personal utilities (morning-briefing), and PreToolUse/PostToolUse safety and formatting hooks.
